Fire (a block demo on Patch)

The fire, embers, light and every dressing in the demo: Patch, MIT. Made in code, with no textures, models or sounds.
The pictures in thumbs/ are stills of this demo.
Inspired by a post by @majidmanzarpour showing volumetric fire in pure three.js. No code came from it.
three.js: MIT, the three.js authors. https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
